ValidationRule.description: Validates basic contact fields before entering Prequalification.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'In Prequalification'), OR(ISBLANK(Company), ISPICKVAL(Salutation, ''), ISBLANK(FirstName), ISBLANK(LastName), ISBLANK(Email), AND(ISBLANK(Phone), ISBLANK(MobilePhone))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage:
Mandatory information is missing for the status change. Please check fields:
-Company -Salutation -First & Last Name -Email -Phone or Mobile
